JUST (JST) – CoinGecko Information Update Request

1. About JUST / What Is JUST (JST)?

Update Type: Replace Existing Description

Current Description (To Be Replaced):

JUST is a decentralized financial platform built on the TRON network, providing various DeFi solutions such as JustStable, JustLend, and cross-chain tokens. It operates through a decentralized stablecoin system comprising USDJ and its governance token, JST. USDJ is a stablecoin paired with the US Dollar.

Proposed Updated Description:

JUST is an open financial network on TRON that serves the global on-chain economy. Its October 2026 brand upgrade brought three core businesses together under one framework. JustLend provides asset lending, sTRX staking and Energy services. USDD provides decentralized stablecoin liquidity and yield products, while GasFree lets users pay transfer fees directly in USDT or USDD.

JST is the JUST ecosystem’s TRC-20 governance token. Holders can submit proposals and vote through JUST DAO. JUST DAO oversees ecosystem governance and uses eligible revenue from the core businesses to fund ongoing JST buybacks. Repurchased tokens are burned on a scheduled basis.

2. How Does JUST Work?

Update Type: Add New FAQ

Proposed Question:

How Does JUST Work?

Proposed Answer:

JUST brings together three on-chain financial services. JustLend lets users supply and borrow assets, stake TRX through sTRX, and access Energy services. USDD provides decentralized stablecoin liquidity through overcollateralized minting, PSM swaps and related yield products. GasFree lets users pay transfer fees directly in USDT or USDD, so they do not need a separate TRX balance to cover those fees.

JST holders participate in ecosystem decisions through JUST DAO. Under the upgraded buyback-and-burn framework, eligible revenue from JustLend, USDD and GasFree funds ongoing JST buybacks. Repurchased tokens are burned on a scheduled basis and removed from circulation.

3. What Is the Fully Diluted Valuation of JUST (JST)?

Update Type: Replace Existing FAQ Answer

Current Answer (To Be Replaced):

The fully diluted valuation (FDV) of JUST (JST) is $1,155,264,548. This is a statistical representation of the maximum market cap, assuming the maximum number of 9.9 Billion JST tokens are in circulation today. Depending on how the emission schedule of JST tokens are designed, it might take multiple years before FDV is realized.

Proposed Updated Answer:

CoinGecko’s displayed fully diluted valuation for JST is calculated using its reported total supply. As of October 28, 2026, both total and circulating supply are approximately 8.018 billion JST, while the initial maximum supply is 9.9 billion. JST’s buyback-and-burn program removes repurchased tokens from circulation, and supply figures are updated as burn activity is reflected in the market data.
